notes.content:

Ollie and the Merchant of Dreams


Hello everyone, and welcome to Hitonero.

After years of solo development, I’m proud to finally unveil Ollie and the Merchant of Dreams, a hand-crafted 2D Metroidvania where gods walk among mortals, dreams fuel magic, and your choices shape the fate of the world.

You play as Ollie, a catfolk scout stranded in a realm unraveling. Reality is breaking apart. Sleep itself has vanished. And the Archons, the gods who once watched over this world seem oblivious to the tragedy plaguing Hitonero. With only your blade, your summons, and a sliver of dream energy, you must uncover the truth behind the fading of dreams… and face the mysterious enemy who seeks to return the world to nothing.

Everything, from the pixel art and level design to the story and music direction, has been built piece by piece in pursuit of a world worth getting lost in.



Wishlist the game now to stay updated as we get closer to launch.

Thank you for being here at the very beginning. I can’t wait to show you more soon.



Lavadrop Entertainment
